LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: POEMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.5 Guided Writing: Imaginative Composition (2 sessions) • Simple senten
Topic 3.7: Guided Writing: Poems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Poems, part of Writing 3.5 Guided Writing: Imaginative Composition (2 sessions) • Simple senten in Grade 9 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can you write an interesting poem?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an audio recording and write vocabulary related to the theme,

2. form sentences using descriptive words and vocabulary identified to express their health states, e.g. I am sick today etc.

3. share sentences with their peers for review,

4. work jointly to compose a poem related to different health states using identified thematic vocabulary,

5. team up to stage their well-written poem during the interclass competition.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an audio recording and write vocabulary related to the theme,
2. form sentences using descriptive words and vocabulary identified to express their health states, e.g. I am sick today etc.
3. share sentences with their peers for review,
4. work jointly to compose a poem related to different health states using identified thematic vocabulary,
5. team up to stage their well-written poem during the interclass competition.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Poems together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with technology when listening to audio recordings related to the

theme.
